hooks.name: Secret and rules guard
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, verify no debug token or API key is committed, .kiro is not git-ignored, and the production bundle contains no remote-code recaptcha scripts.

action.command: npm run --silent check:secrets && ! grep -nE '(^|/)\.kiro' .gitignore && (test ! -d dist || npm run --silent check:bundle-rhc)
